drift: D2.5 from machine-readable official aggregates to lawful purpose-specific reuse and privacy release gate

A.question: Does an identifiable official Congreso open-data license explicitly establish a reusable legal basis for republishing/processing identifiable deputy voting records into a commercial or gamified person-score service, rather than merely permitting access?
A.population: Public official webpages and applicable Spanish/EU reuse and data-protection guidance
A.estimand: Documentary gap between official source-access rights and separate person-profiling lawfulness
A.outcome: An explicit, attributable rights statement covering specified reuse and conditions, or absence of such proof; no legal opinion or automatic license inferred

B.H1: Congress explicitly grants open license for machine data and use case covers personal automated rankings including necessary privacy notices/rights
B.H0: Official access/reuse status does NOT by itself establish lawful scoring/profiling: need separate lawful basis, transparency, minimization and rights assessment
B.Hother: Site gives bounded license for non-personal reuse only, and legal text requires case-specific analysis

C.primary: Find first-party Congreso notice/license and original regulatory text/AEPD guidance; quote exact scope and whether profiling or derivative commercial scores are addressed
negative_controls: Open data label alone is not an Art 6 GDPR lawful basis
Public person identity on a page is not affirmative consent for every reuse
Presence of law 37/2007 alone doesn't prove identifiable-score entitlement
C.budget: Up to 4 official/source searches and 5 direct reads; stop if authoritative texts unavailable
C.falsifier: Official use-specific explicit permit (including privacy compliance) exists with enough precision to support the given fantasy workflow; else rights gate stays blocked

D.sources: Prefer congreso.es, boe.es, aepd.es, EUR-Lex official legal text
D.network: web-only, no actual processing of person-level records

F: Non-lawyer source audit is not binding legal determination; distinguish legal permission, terms and GDPR lawful basis
G: Independent legal or DPO review required before release
H: No CT2 identity or scientific grade changes
I: Compliance gating for product; public data access not identity scoring permission
J: Keep rights gate 0/6 unless verified explicit purpose-specific evidence exists.
